assurance_case_justification: The security model names the trust boundaries, the guarantees at each (SM-1 to SM-8), what is not promised, and the tests that enforce each guarantee: https://github.com/ts-graphviz/ts-graphviz/blob/main/website/docs/ts-graphviz/11-advanced-topics/06-security-model.md
automated_integration_testing_justificat: Every pull request runs unit tests and E2E tests that install the packed packages into CJS/ESM and JavaScript/TypeScript projects.
build_non_recursive_justification: This package is a general JavaScript library.
build_preserve_debug_justification: This package is a general JavaScript library.
build_standard_variables_justification: This package does not provide native binaries.
coding_standards_justification: Biome (lint and format) and TypeScript strict mode, enforced in CI: https://github.com/ts-graphviz/ts-graphviz/blob/main/biome.json
dependency_monitoring_justification: Dependabot (https://github.com/ts-graphviz/ts-graphviz/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml), CodeQL and OpenSSF Scorecard workflows; development-only findings are tracked with reasons in osv-scanner.toml.
discussion_justification: GitHub supports discussions on issues and pull requests.
documentation_current_justification: The documentation site and API reference are built from the repository on each release.
documentation_security_justification: The security model states what users can and cannot expect, and the security settings: https://github.com/ts-graphviz/ts-graphviz/blob/main/website/docs/ts-graphviz/11-advanced-topics/06-security-model.md
dynamic_analysis_justification: Coverage-guided fuzzing with Jazzer.js (https://github.com/ts-graphviz/ts-graphviz/tree/main/fuzz), property-based tests with fast-check, differential tests against the Graphviz binaries.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification:
Testing is being conducted at Vitest and is in the process of CI/CD.

https://github.com/ts-graphviz/ts-graphviz/blob/main/vitest.config.ts
external_dependencies_justification: Dependencies are declared in each package.json and locked in pnpm-lock.yaml.
floss_license_justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
floss_license_osi_justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
hardening_justification: No shell in the adapter, options from own properties only (prototype-pollution resistant), bounded parsing and printing.
implement_secure_design_justification: Options are read from own properties only; the adapter runs dot without a shell; the parser bounds nesting, edge chains and HTML-like depth; the printer escapes values instead of printing them raw.
input_validation_justification: The DOT parser rejects input beyond its nesting, edge-chain and HTML-like depth limits with an error, and the adapter accepts only known options.
installation_common_justification:
Since it is an npm package, it can be installed and uninstalled via npm and other package managers.

https://www.npmjs.com/package/ts-graphviz
installation_development_quick_justifica: pnpm install, pnpm build, pnpm test: https://github.com/ts-graphviz/ts-graphviz/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
installation_standard_variables_justific: There is no build or other process when installed. Also, since it is an npm package, the pre-built source code is generally deployed under the node_modules directory.
interfaces_current_justification: The API reference is generated from the source with TypeDoc: https://ts-graphviz.github.io/ts-graphviz/
license_location_justification: Non-trivial license location file in repository: <https://github.com/ts-graphviz/ts-graphviz/blob/main/LICENSE>.
regression_tests_added50_justification: Each fix comes with a test that fails without it, for example the 2026-10 security fixes: https://github.com/ts-graphviz/ts-graphviz/security/advisories
repo_distributed_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git is distributed.
repo_public_justification: Repository on GitHub, which provides public git repositories with URLs.
repo_track_justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git can track the changes, who made them, and when they were made.
sites_password_security_justification: The project sites (GitHub, GitHub Pages, npm) store no passwords of their own.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j:
GitHub Actions to run CodeQL and static analysis in Biome.

https://github.com/ts-graphviz/ts-graphviz/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql-analysis.yml
https://github.com/ts-graphviz/ts-graphviz/blob/main/.github/workflows/.check.yaml
updateable_reused_components_justificati: All dependencies come from npm through pnpm-lock.yaml and are updated by Dependabot; nothing is vendored.
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: Reporters are credited in the published advisories: https://github.com/ts-graphviz/ts-graphviz/security/advisories
